newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up 25 cents on London's strength.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up 25 cents on London's strength.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed 25 cents higher at 14.35 ringgit ($5.75) a kg on continued foreign demand, traders said.
They said market sentiment was helped by a $125-rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight.
"There was again strong demand from Japan and Europe," said one trader. He expects further gains this week.
Turnover was 130 tonnes, up from 100 on Tuesday.
The local price premium over LME has narrowed slightly to $70 a tonne from $75 previously, traders said.
